Traffic Advisory
Day 10, 6th October, 2025
Construction of Mohammed Isa Road Extension in Asokoro Abuja.

Motorists plying Asokoro, especially those using Hassan Kastina Road, Mohamed Isma Street, Mahatir Mohammed Street and other nearby locations, that traffic will be slightly affected during movement of dignitaries to Aminu Ifesinachi Crescent, Asokoro District, Abuja - venue of the event.

The intersection of Deng Xiaopong Street and Mahatir Mohammed Street will be covered by traffic and security personnel to ensure seamless flow.
Your patience and cooperation is highly solicited.

- Head Traffic, DRTS

The Mariana Trench is 35,814 feet deep and is located in the western Pacific Ocean, east of the Philippines and south of Japan. 

It's deepest point, the Challenger Deep, lies approximately 10,916 meters (35,814 feet) below sea level and is considered the deepest known place on Earth.

The trench is situated about 200 kilometers southwest of Guam, the nearest major island and part of the Mariana Islands. 

It is approximately 2,500 kilometers from Manila, the capital of the Philippines. 

The Mariana Trench was formed by the subduction of the Pacific Plate beneath the Mariana Plate and is part of the geologically active Ring of Fire. 

Due to its extreme depth and immense pressure, it remains one of the least explored places in the world. @grok ?
